newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 26.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Monday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- All Nippon Airways Co Ltd chairman Takaya Sugiura is likely to announce his resignation today.
-- Telecommunications firms to cooperate with Construction Ministry on optical-fibre communications system.
-- Government advisory panel on fiscal structural reform to favour freeze on new railway construction projects for Shinkansen bullet trains.
-- Posts and Telecommunications Ministry to let telecommunications firms utilise radio frequencies for inter-city phone calls.
-- Fiscal reform panel to recommend front-loading by one year budget reduction review for midterm defence build-up programme.
-- Health and Welfare Ministry decides to start making public results of its screening of clinical tests for new medicines.
-- Russia's virtually full participation in Denver summit confirmed.
-- Denver summit to witness fewer economic discussions. -- Police alert on pro-company corporate racketeers ahead of season for shareholders' meetings.
-- Government to revise banking law to stiffen penalties to deter bank reports' falsification.
